title: By His Wounds We Are Healed

request.style: English, female jazz vocal, smooth and sorrowful, solo with soft choir, upright piano, double bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Who has believed our message
And to whom was the arm revealed
He grew like a root in dry ground
No beauty to draw our eyes

[Verse]
Despised and rejected by men
A man of sorrows and grief
We hid our faces from him
And held him of no account

[Chorus]
Yet it was our griefs he bore
Our sorrows he carried alone
We thought him struck by God
But pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
By his wounds we are healed

[Verse]
The punishment brought us peace
Laid upon him was the weight
All we have strayed like sheep
Turned to our own ways
The Lord laid on him
The iniquity of us all

[Chorus]
Yet it was our griefs he bore
Our sorrows he carried alone
We thought him struck by God
But pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
By his wounds we are healed

[Bridge]
Oppressed and afflicted
He did not open his mouth
Like a lamb to slaughter
Silent before shearers
He gave up his life
For the transgression of my people

[Chorus]
Yet it was our griefs he bore
Our sorrows he carried alone
We thought him struck by God
But pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
By his wounds we are healed

[Outro]
By his wounds we are healed
By his wounds we are healed
